Install this APK on a Samsung phone.

Home for this app: https://github.com/MCdigital-design/Health-App
Moved from: https://github.com/MCdigital-design/alphatrend-mt5-qa/pull/1

This is an UPDATE (same signing key as previous builds). If you already
installed a version, just install this one on top - no need to uninstall.

1. Copy verity-dashboard.apk to the phone.
2. Open it with My Files (not Chrome if possible).
3. Allow Install unknown apps for My Files, if asked again.
4. If Play Protect warns: More details -> Install anyway.

Requires Android 8.0 or newer. Release-signed (not debug/testOnly).
SHA256: ed1950b81b8158fd7610d9f26288a0b066192147a0bf27e6c0fac0d57757f44e

WHAT'S NEW IN THIS BUILD (v1.2.2 — lean chart numbers):

- Tapping a point no longer dumps 14 decimal places
  (158.93333333333334 / 330032.4891472868). The chart chip is a whole
  number; the blue box keeps the trimmed fraction. Raw SQLite is unchanged.

WHAT'S NEW IN THE PREVIOUS BUILD (v1.2.1 — Live axes and PPG already-running):

- Live timeframe chips name the window (Real-time / 30s / 2m / 10m / 30m / 2h).
- Chart Y ticks are even numbers. The exact last sample sits in the colored chip.
- Live X axis uses now / -10m, not -600s.
- App bar shows the connected device id.
- PPG no longer restarts every few seconds just because Polar timestamps
  are on a different clock (that was the ERROR_ALREADY_IN_STATE overlay).

WHAT'S NEW IN THE PREVIOUS BUILD (v1.2.0 — session charts, motion, storage):

- Session Heart Rate no longer shows "No data" when HR rows exist (was
  hidden behind the first 5,000 PPG rows).
- Session charts use elapsed time on X, compact Y labels, pinch/drag zoom.
- Accelerometer starts on new recordings by default.
- Storage / Polar / GitHub privacy copy, plus delete-all in Settings.

Previous build's fixes are still included (SDK Mode, HR retry, etc).

WHAT'S NEW IN THE PREVIOUS BUILD (fixes a 12-minute-recording-with-zero-HR bug):

- Fixed a real root cause: toggling SDK Mode while a stream (e.g. PPG)
  was already running caused the sensor to silently reject the mode
  change (Polar's own documented INVALID_STATE behavior). The app now
  stops all active streams first, changes the mode, re-verifies the
  sensor's actual state afterward (instead of assuming the request
  worked), and restarts whatever was running before.
- Added continuous auto-retry for Heart Rate (and PPG): if a stream never
  successfully starts on the first attempt, or stops for any reason, the
  app now retries every 20 seconds automatically instead of giving up
  after a single failed attempt.
- Added a persistent orange "Heart rate is not active" banner on the
  Live tab with a manual Retry button, so this is now visible immediately
  instead of only a brief, easy-to-miss message.

Previous build's fixes are still included:
- Chart flatlining/flickering fixes, timeframe selector, adaptive charts
- Recordings tab auto-refresh (sessions were never actually lost, just
  not shown without a manual reload)
- Session detail view with per-signal sample counts and CSV export
- Optional Polar Flow (cloud) import for historical exercises

If Heart Rate still shows nothing after connecting: open Settings and
check "SDK Mode" is off, then check the Live tab for the new "Heart rate
is not active" banner and tap Retry.

Full audit and manual test checklist: apps/verity_dashboard/QA_AUDIT.md
